title: Missing handling for EOFError
detail: The code does not handle EOFError, only KeyboardInterrupt. This can lead to a crash if EOF is encountered.

title: Incorrect handling of ClickException
detail: The code incorrectly handles ClickException by invoking its show method and then exiting with its exit_code. This is not the correct behavior for ClickException.

title: Inverted condition
detail: The condition `if not standalone_mode:` is inverted. This can cause a late interrupt to be caught and handled incorrectly.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The code does not handle the case where standalone_mode is False, which can lead to a late interrupt not being caught and resulting in an unhandled traceback.

title: Incorrect handling of EOF nodes in hidden value
detail: The code incorrectly concatenates the prefix of each EOF node to the hidden value without checking if the node is a DEDENT or ENDMARKER.

title: Missing test for fmt: off unclosed trailing blank lines
detail: The test_fmt_off_unclosed_trailing_blank_lines test does not check for the preservation of trailing blank lines at the end of a file when a # fmt: off block is not closed.

title: Missing initialization of link ID
detail: The link ID is not initialized if either `link` or `meta` is not provided, which can lead to unexpected behavior.
note: Says no link id is made when only one of link or meta is given, which the planted `and` does.

title: Incorrect condition for acquiring the export lock
detail: The condition `if not self._export_lock.locked:` is incorrect because `locked` is a method, not an attribute. This will raise a `TypeError` when trying to call it.

title: Incorrect behavior of accept_html
detail: The method now incorrectly returns True if 'text/html' is not accepted, instead of checking if 'text/html' is accepted or if accept_xhtml is True.
note: Says it returns True when text/html is not accepted.

title: Deprecation warning not handled correctly
detail: The method does not correctly handle the deprecation warning and does not provide clear instructions on how to replace 'accept_xhtml'.
